title: Account Coordinator
Account Coordinator
description:
Candidate Consultant (Account Coordinator)

Location: Hull
Salary: 27,700 per annum
Hours: 40 hours per week
Contract: Full Time, Permanent

Join the Stafforce Team

At Stafforce, we're passionate about connecting people with opportunities and helping our clients build reliable, skilled workforces. We are looking for a proactive and organised Candidate Consultant (Account Coordinator) to join our team, supporting a number of key client accounts across the Hull area.
This is a varied, fast-paced role where no two days are the same. You'll play a vital part in the candidate journey, from sourcing and onboarding workers through to supporting their assignments and ensuring our clients receive an outstanding service.

The Role

As a Candidate Consultant, you will work closely with our recruitment and account management teams to support the delivery of temporary workforce solutions. You will be responsible for coordinating worker onboarding, conducting inductions, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring workers are fully supported throughout their employment.
This role is primarily office-based but will involve travel to client sites across the Hull area to support onboarding and workforce activities.
The standard working hours are 8:30am to 5:00pm, Monday to Friday, however flexibility is essential as some client requirements may require early starts. You will also participate in an out-of-hours and weekend on-call rota to support our clients and workforce when needed.

Key Responsibilities
- Support recruitment activities by sourcing and coordinating suitable candidates.
- Conduct candidate registrations and onboarding processes.
- Deliver worker inductions and site briefings.
- Complete compliance checks, right-to-work verification, and employment documentation.
- Maintain accurate records using Stafforce's internal systems and databases.
- Update and manage workforce data using Microsoft Excel and other software packages.
- Build strong relationships with candidates, workers, clients, and colleagues.
- Monitor worker attendance and assist with shift coordination.
- Support workforce planning and fulfil client staffing requirements.
- Resolve worker queries and provide ongoing support throughout assignments.
- Ensure all processes are completed accurately and in line with company procedures.
- Participate in the out-of-hours and weekend on-call rota.
- Travel between client sites and offices as required.

What We're Looking For
Essential Skills & Experience
- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
- Strong IT and administrative skills.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- Confident using databases, software systems, and Microsoft Office applications.
- Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail.
- Ability to prioritise workload and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong customer service and relationship-building skills.
- A flexible and positive approach to work.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Desirable Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in recruitment, account coordination, administration, customer service, or a similar role.
- Experience working with temporary workers or high-volume staffing environments.
- Full UK driving licence due to travel requirements across multiple client locations in the Hull area.

What You'll Receive

In return, Stafforce offers a supportive environment where you can develop your career and make a real difference to both candidates and clients.

Benefits Include:
- Competitive salary of 27,700 per annum.
- Full training and ongoing development opportunities.
- Career progression within a well-established and growing business.
- 24/7 GP access through our employee wellbeing programme.
- Emotional wellbeing and mental health support.
- High street discounts across a wide range of retailers, restaurants, leisure providers, and services.
- Access to a supportive and collaborative team culture.

S15

About Us

We are dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive community. In line with our Diversity and Inclusion policy, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability. As a Disability Confident Employer, and part of the Nicholas Associates Group, we are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities, and we're happy to discuss flexible working options.

We are committed to protecting the privacy of all our candidates and clients. If you choose to apply, your information will be processed in accordance with the Nicholas Associates Group of companies Privacy Notice.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Are you an organised, proactive and friendly administrator looking for a flexible part-time opportunity within education? This is to start ASAP, is a temporary position, and will initially last until about 18th December 2026.

The Role
- Position: College Administrator
- Location: Central Hull
- Hours: 8:30am-4:30pm

Key Responsibilities

As a College Administrator, you will play a vital role in the day-to-day running of the college, providing efficient administrative support to teaching staff, students, senior leaders and visitors.

General Administration
- Providing comprehensive administrative support to the college office and wider staff team.

- Is proactive, adaptable and able to use their own initiative.
- Understands the importance of safeguarding and maintaining a safe environment for students.
- Is reliable, punctual and committed to providing a high standard of administrative support.

To join us and be successful in this role you will need to:
- Have experience working within an administrative environment
- Enhanced DBS Disclosure, Overseas Police Clearances (if applicable) and professional reference checks

title: BOM Administrator
salary_text: £28000 - £30000 per year (Regular days, 37.5 hours per week)
description:
BOM Administrator

Location: Hull, UK

Salary: 28k - 30k

A Manufacturing company is recruiting for the role of a BOM Administrator who will be responsible for the creation and maintenance of an accurate bill of materials for manufacturing and after-sales within project and production timescales.

The ideal candidate will be a highly motivated and organised individual who has can work well under pressure ensuring an excellent standard of attention to detail.

You will have the opportunity to be part of a fast-paced, dynamic environment renowned for innovation, quality construction, stylish design and outstanding value! The Product Development department generate and maintain engineering drawings and bill of materials for every model, hundreds of drawings are created, modified and issued every week.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
- Working with the Product Engineer for each product group to develop an engineering BOM for each model, providing the rest of the company with expertise and technical support.
- Ensure Safety critical and Type Approval components are accurately identified on databases and BOMs.
- Assisting the Project Manager and BOM Team Leader on measuring the progress of projects by compiling and assessing KPI's and Critical Data information.
- Create and maintain bills of material with the aid of the Product Engineer for new products.
- Assess cost, weight and complexity of new models and refine such information during product execution.
- Liaise with other members of the project team to resolve process & operational issues that inhibit effective project delivery.
- Adopt best practice tools & techniques for project information work in order to maximise efficiency and quality of output.
- Link and update parts for the After-sales and IDOL data base systems with the latest data and photographic images.
- Support the D&D Technical Support Team with information and support with direct communication with customers and dealers when requested.
- Compliance with Health & Safety requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
- 5 GCSE or equivalent in English & Math and a high standard of further education (ONC or HNC level preferable)
- Additional qualifications or evidence of training in Data Management would be an advantage
- Familiar with BOM & database tools techniques
- Familiar with Microsoft Office programmes (Excel, Word etc)
- Ability to work under minimum supervision
- Strong problem solving & decision-making skills
- Ability to work well under pressure to achieve deadlines
- High level of accuracy in work and strong attention to detail
- Flexible, adaptable, enthusiastic and motivated
- Excellent verbal & written communication skills

BENEFITS
- 5 hour week
- 27 days annual leave plus 8 bank holidays
- Early finish Friday
- Easy access to site & free on-site parking
- Free Gym Membership

- Maintaining accurate facilities records, compliance documentation and building safety information.

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
Logistics Coordinator

Hull

Permanent Full-time

A well-established logistics business in Hull is looking to appoint a Logistics Coordinator to join its busy operations team.

This position would suit someone who enjoys working in a structured, deadline-led environment and is confident managing moving parts across transport, documentation and operational support. The hours follow a rotating pattern, so flexibility around working times is important.

The opportunity

This role centres around keeping freight movements on track from start to finish, making sure everything is lined up correctly for smooth onward movement. You will be involved in organising load activity, maintaining accurate system records, coordinating with internal departments and helping avoid disruption, delay or unnecessary spend.

Attention to detail is key, particularly where timings, system updates and operational paperwork are concerned.

Responsibilities
- Coordinate daily freight activity to ensure movements are arranged in line with customer and operational requirements
- Keep internal systems updated with accurate movement information and shipment status details
- Make sure vehicle and load activity is prepared in advance to avoid issues at site access points
- Check all operational paperwork is in place and chase anything outstanding before movement takes place
- Work closely with other teams to keep cargo flowing efficiently through the network
- Monitor shipment progress and help resolve issues that could affect service or timing
- Arrange additional operational support such as short-term holding space where required
- Maintain clear and accurate records across shipment references and release information
- Support overall service performance by helping the team meet operational expectations and deadlines

About you
- Previous experience within logistics, freight, shipping, transport coordination or a similar operational environment
- Strong organisational skills and a high level of attention to detail
- Ability to manage live operational information accurately and efficiently
- Comfortable using internal systems and updating records in real time
- Able to work well in a fast-paced environment and respond to changing demands
- Good communication skills with a practical, team-focused approach
- Exposure to import/export activity, freight forwarding, port-related operations or logistics administration would be an advantage

Why join?
- Join an established and growing business

title: Procurement Coordinator
description:
Procurement Coordinator

Location: Site-based, Hull, HU2 8 QS

Salary: £28,000-£32,000, dependent on experience

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00am-5:00pm

Contract: Full-time, permanent

Closing date: Sunday 1st November 2026

About FR Scott

FR Scott is one of Hull's leading independent suppliers of fixings, fasteners, architectural ironmongery, tools and industrial consumables. Established in 1945, we support customers across construction, engineering, manufacturing and modular building from our Hull trade counter, warehouse and national ecommerce operation.

The opportunity

We are looking for an organised, practical person to help keep purchasing and supply running reliably, while supporting the Head of Procurement in developing the wider function.

Day-to-day purchasing, stock availability and supplier coordination are central to this role. Alongside these responsibilities, you will support sourcing, commercial analysis, product and category development, and projects to improve how we buy and manage supply across the business.

FR Scott is a small business. Responsibilities overlap, and we need someone who takes ownership, works closely with colleagues and is willing to provide support and cover where needed. Procurement includes both the products we buy to sell and the goods and services we buy to run the business.

What you'll be doing
- Manage day-to-day purchasing and replenishment, maintaining accurate purchase orders, supplier acknowledgements, costs and delivery dates.
- Follow up outstanding orders and resolve shortages, delivery discrepancies and invoice queries, working closely with Sales, Warehouse and Finance.
- Support supplier sourcing and negotiations by obtaining and comparing quotations, benchmarking prices and identifying opportunities to improve cost, quality and availability.
- Analyse sales, stock, margin and supplier spend to support buying decisions, range reviews and commercial improvements.
- Support inventory and supplier performance reviews, helping address slow-moving stock, availability issues and recurring supply problems.
- Maintain accurate product and supplier information, including specifications, pricing and technical documentation, and support new products and range development for Fix&Fast.
- Contribute to supplier onboarding, purchasing controls, reporting and improvements to procurement processes and digital tools.
- Take responsibility for agreed suppliers, product groups and projects as your knowledge develops, providing support and cover across the wider team.

About you

You may already work in purchasing, buying or supply chain, or have relevant experience in product administration, ecommerce, sales coordination, order management or merchandising. Industry experience would be useful, but it is not essential.
- Strong attention to detail and good organisational skills.
- Confidence communicating with suppliers and colleagues and following actions through.
- Confidence using Excel to analyse sales, stock and purchasing data, compare quotations and maintain accurate records.
- An interest in products, pricing, stock and supplier performance.
- A proactive approach, commercial awareness and willingness to take ownership.

Development and progression

Working directly with the Head of Procurement, you will gain experience across buying, supplier management, stock and category development, with opportunities to take ownership of suppliers, product groups and projects as your skills grow.

This could support progression into Buyer, Category Manager or wider procurement and supply chain roles, depending on your strengths and business opportunities. Support towards a relevant CIPS qualification may be available following successful completion of probation.

What we offer
- £28,000-£32,000 salary, dependent on experience.
- 23 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing with length of service.
- Annual bonus scheme and company pension.
- Employee discount, on-site parking and sick pay.
- Training and development opportunities.

Apply

Apply through this advert with your CV. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

Closing date: Sunday 1st November 2026

Equals One is an advertising and recruitment agency working on behalf of our client to promote this vacancy. You may be contacted directly by the employer should they wish to progress your application. Due to the number of applications we receive, we are unable to provide specific feedback if your application is unsuccessful.

title: Treasury Administrator
description:
Who we are

GlobalData operates an intelligence platform that empowers leaders to act decisively in a world of complexity and change.

By uniting proprietary data, human expertise, and purpose-built AI into a single, connected platform, we help organisations see what s coming, move faster, and lead with confidence.

Our solutions are used by over 5,000 organisations across the world s largest industries, delivering tailored intelligence that supports strategic planning, innovation, risk management, and sustainable growth.

Why join GlobalData?

GlobalData is at a pivotal point in its growth journey, and we need curious, ambitious, courageous people to support us in achieving our vision to deliver intelligence that transforms uncertainty into opportunity for the world s most successful organisations.?

Our big ambitions mean that life at GlobalData is fast-paced, entrepreneurial and rewarding. Working together in an intellectually challenging environment, where learning is super-charged to keep us on our toes, the highly stimulating, fast-paced, global environment we operate in, and our bold ambitions result in unique learning opportunities for our people.

The role

We now have an opening for a Treasury Administrator within the Treasury Team based in Hull. Working within the finance team, we expect you to have close interaction with the wider commercial business, with the main responsibility being production of daily bank reconciliations and processing of payments.

Now is an incredibly exciting time to join and be part of a business that is fast-paced, vibrant and ambitious, with opportunities for everyone to develop and succeed.

What you ll be doing
- Producing daily bank reconciliations in multi currencies
- Cash allocation of bank receipts and payments
- Resolving cash allocation queries
- Ledger maintenance
- Liaising with purchase ledger, credit control
- Creation of manual purchase ledger payments
- Bank and credit card administration

What we re looking for
- AAT Qualified, or experience of working in a similar role.
- Technical skills - with strong Excel skills and analytical ability.
- Dedicated and accountable - able to meet deadlines while maintaining strong attention to detail and effectively managing expectations.
- Organised - able to meet deadlines while maintaining strong attention to detail as well as managing expectations effectively.
- A strong communicator - able to communicate well and build strong, collaborative relationships across the business.
- Adaptable and positive mindset - a confident personality with a positive attitude towards change and new challenges.

In addition to a rewarding career, we support our GlobalData colleagues with a range of benefits across health, finances, fitness, travel, tech and more. To find out more about the roles and benefits on offer in your region, visit (url removed)

GlobalData believes strongly in the value of diversity and creating supportive, inclusive environments where our colleagues can succeed. As such, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. GlobalData is determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.

title: Administrator
company: Hull University Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust

description: Band 2 Administrator Have you ever thought about working for the NHS? Behind every appointment, every clinic, every patient seen - there is someone who made it happen. Our Administrators are the unseen heroes of patient care.They support teams, coordinate workloads, and ensure clinics and departments run safely and efficiently. They are trusted, reliable and central to the smooth delivery of care. Working within fast-paced and supportive teams, you will take on additional responsibility, helping to oversee processes, support colleagues and ensure patients receive the best possible experience. The reassuring voice on the phone. The calm presence supporting patients in what can often be their most worrying moments. Without them, patients don't get seen. Services don't run. Care doesn't flow. You don't need previous NHS experience - we can teach you the systems. What we can't teach is compassion, professionalism and the ability to care about getting things right for patients. That's what we're looking for. What you'll bring: A caring and compassionate approach Confidence communicating with patients and the public Good organisational skills and attention to detail Basic IT skills (typing, email, data entry, use of computer systems) The ability to work as part of a close-knit team Calmness in a sometimes fast-paced environment What you'll gain: The chance to make a real difference every single day Part-time opportunities with flexible working options One of the best pension schemes available Generous annual leave entitlement - because you work hard and deserve proper time off Structured training and ongoing support Genuine career progression - many of our senior leaders began in administrative roles Patient care is at the heart of everything we do, and our administrative teams are central to making that care possible. If you are organised, compassionate, and want a role where your work truly matters, we would love to hear from you. For further details with regard to this vacancy opportunity, please see the attached Job Description and Person Specification.
